mv_aggregate.comment: GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(col) plans as an MV aggregate. On a scan it runs inside the leaf stage, above a join it runs as MvAggregateOperator. The expected rows follow single-stage engine semantics: one group per element, a repeated element counts once per copy, two MV keys give the cartesian product, a null array forms one null group, and an empty array contributes to no group. This test setup reads the input [] of row k=4 back as a null array, so it forms the null group. A real empty array comes from filterMv (row k=5 for v > 1). The physical optimizer does not support the MV aggregate, so every case sets ignoreV2Optimizer.

queries.description: Single MV key on a scan: one group per element, a repeated element counts per copy
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)

queries.description: Single MV key on a scan with the gate off gives the same rows
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=false; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)

queries.description: CROSS JOIN UNNEST gives the same rows as the MV aggregate, except that it drops the null array
queries.sql: SELECT u.e, COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} CROSS JOIN UNNEST({tbl}.strMv) AS u(e) GROUP BY u.e

queries.description: Single INT MV key with COUNT and SUM of an SV column on a scan: the SV value is added once per element
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(intMv), COUNT(*), SUM(sv) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(intMv)

queries.description: Two MV keys on a scan give the cartesian product per row
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(intMv), ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(intMv), ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)

queries.description: MV key and SV key with SUM on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), grp, SUM(sv) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), grp

queries.description: Single MV key above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)

queries.description: Single INT MV key with COUNT and SUM above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.intMv), COUNT(*), SUM(t2.sv) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.intMv)

queries.description: Two MV keys above a self-join, one from each side
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.intMv), ARRAY_TO_MV(t2.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.intMv), ARRAY_TO_MV(t2.strMv)

queries.description: MV key and SV key with SUM above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), t2.grp, SUM(t2.sv) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), t2.grp

queries.description: MV key in a subquery on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT key, cnt FROM (SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) AS key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)) WHERE cnt > 1

queries.description: MV key in a subquery above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT key, cnt FROM (SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) AS key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)) WHERE cnt > 1

queries.description: DISTINCT on an MV key on a scan. Without aggregate calls the leaf returns the stored default value 'null' for the null array of row k=4, the same as with the gate off
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT DISTINCT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: DISTINCT on an MV key above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT DISTINCT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.intMv) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k

queries.description: MV key with ORDER BY and LIMIT on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) ORDER BY cnt DESC, ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) LIMIT 2

queries.description: MV key with ORDER BY and LIMIT and group trim above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_enable_group_trim='true') */ ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) ORDER BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) LIMIT 2

queries.description: MV key with HAVING on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

queries.description: A filter on the MV key in HAVING keeps only the matching element above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) HAVING ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) = 'b'

queries.description: A filter on the MV key in HAVING keeps only the matching element on a scan with the gate off
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=false; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) HAVING ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) = 'b'

queries.description: A filter on the MV key in an outer query keeps only the matching element
queries.sql: SELECT key, cnt FROM (SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) AS key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)) WHERE key = 'b'

queries.description: The default mode, auto, plans the MV aggregate above a self-join because the query fails without it
queries.sql: SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)

queries.description: The default mode, auto, plans the MV aggregate above CROSS JOIN UNNEST: one group per element of strMv for each unnested row
queries.sql: SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} CROSS JOIN UNNEST({tbl}.intMv) AS u(e) GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.strMv)

queries.description: MV key with HAVING above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

queries.description: MV key with a FILTER clause on a scan
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sv > 0) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)

queries.description: MV key with a FILTER clause above a self-join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t2.sv > 0) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)

queries.description: MV key over filterMv on a scan: a row whose array becomes empty contributes to no group
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(filterMv(intMv, 'v > 1')), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(filterMv(intMv, 'v > 1'))

queries.description: MV key over filterMv above a self-join: a row whose array becomes empty contributes to no group
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(filterMv(t1.strMv, 'v = ''a''')), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(filterMv(t1.strMv, 'v = ''a'''))

queries.description: MV key above a lookup join runs in the leaf fragment as MvAggregateOperator
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='lookup') */ ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} JOIN {dim} ON {tbl}.k = {dim}.id GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.strMv)

queries.description: MV key and a dimension-table key above a lookup join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='lookup') */ ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.intMv), {dim}.name, COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} JOIN {dim} ON {tbl}.k = {dim}.id GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV({tbl}.intMv), {dim}.name

queries.description: A nested ARRAY_TO_MV key above a join fails
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY LOWER(ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv))
queries.expectedException: .*ARRAY_TO_MV found in PROJECT in the intermediate stage.*ARRAY_TO_MV is supported only.*

queries.description: The gate off keeps the error for an MV key above a join
queries.sql: SET useMvAggregate=false; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)

mv_aggregate_null_handling.comment: With column-based null handling the MV column is nullable. A null row forms one null group, as in the single-stage engine. CROSS JOIN UNNEST differs here: it drops the null row. ARRAY_TO_MV has the component type of the array, as before the MV aggregate, in every mode. So the planner folds ARRAY_TO_MV(col) IS NOT NULL to TRUE and removes COALESCE around it.

queries.description: A null row forms a null group on a scan
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv)

queries.description: A null row forms a null group above a self-join
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv)

queries.description: CROSS JOIN UNNEST drops the null row instead of forming a null group
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT u.e, COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} CROSS JOIN UNNEST({tbl}.strMv) AS u(e) GROUP BY u.e

queries.description: ARRAY_TO_MV(col) IS NOT NULL is folded to TRUE and keeps the null row
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} WHERE ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv) IS NOT NULL

queries.description: COALESCE around an MV key is removed, in the default mode
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), 'none'), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY 1

queries.description: COALESCE around an MV key is removed, with the gate on
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SET useMvAggregate=true; SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), 'none'), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} GROUP BY 1

queries.description: COALESCE around an MV key is removed above a self-join
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_TO_MV(t1.strMv), 'none'), COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} t1 JOIN {tbl} t2 ON t1.k = t2.k GROUP BY 1

queries.description: COALESCE around ARRAY_TO_MV in a filter is removed
queries.sql: SET enableNullHandling=true; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tbl} WHERE COALESCE(ARRAY_TO_MV(strMv), 'x') = 'a'
